This is NOT an interior design photo, not a wide room overview: no sofa, chairs, broad walls, distant desk, decorative room as main subject. Crisp detailed devices in foreground; environment is only softly blurred supporting hints behind them. Reserve the lowest 28-30% as a smooth calm matte dark surface/low-detail shadow for an app carousel; no essential controls, logos, bright patterns or props in that bottom strip. No interface or text overlaid, no collage, no people, no marble, no racing equipment. Warm sophisticated realistic product lighting with clearly visible device details. No readable invented brand lettering. WINTER DAY variant: a subtle small blurred glimpse of snowy outdoors or cool winter daylight behind the devices, mixed with warm amber interior highlights. The season must remain subordinate to the hardware.

NO television dominating the frame, NO room view, NO PC.
